description.en-US: This is the official Android app for c3nav, the map & indoor navigation software at the Chaos Communication Congress which you can find at c3nav.de. With this app, you get to use c3nav with native Android features, including: * Easier navigation * WiFi-based location * Sharing locations * Creating location shortcuts on your home screen
